adjudication.rationale: The diff changes PostRevisor#update_post from unconditional `@post.save` to `@post.save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations])`, introducing new opts-dependent behavior. In this PR, TopicEmbed.import’s update path calls `revisor.revise!(..., skip_validations: true, bypass_rate_limiter: true)`, so the new branch is relied upon. However, the added/modified specs (e.g., spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb) only assert that an update results in changed cooked content; they don’t verify that validations are skipped when `skip_validations: true` nor that validations still run for normal edits. This is a specific, diff-grounded missing-test concern rather than a demonstrable defect.
